verdicts.reason: I'd ship neither as is, but B is clearly the better resize. A breaks the headline into four short stacked lines that crowd the left side. The chevrons are blown up to a huge size in the bottom-left, where they compete with the nurse illustration. The nurse is pushed to the right, and her flat-cut lower edge now floats above the canvas bottom when it should run off the edge, so the composition looks lopsided and arbitrary. B keeps the original's centred order (headline, then chevrons, then nurse) with sensible two-line wrapping and the right hierarchy. However, its illustration also stops short of the bottom edge, leaving a visible band of empty background below the crop line that looks like a mistake, and the space between headline, chevrons and figure feels slightly tight.
